title: Generic Identity Function
description: A function that returns whatever type is passed in.
explanation_md: Generics allow you to create reusable components that can work over a variety of types rather than a single one.

title: Interface with Optional Properties
description: Defines the shape of an object with some non-mandatory fields.
explanation_md: Interfaces define contracts for objects. Optional properties are denoted with a `?`.

title: Discriminated Unions
description: Pattern for handling multiple types with a common literal property.
explanation_md: Discriminated unions use a common property (the discriminant) to allow the compiler to narrow down the specific type.

title: Utility Type: Partial
description: Makes all properties of a type optional.
explanation_md: `Partial<T>` constructs a type with all properties of T set to optional.

title: Readonly Array
code:
const list: readonly number[] = [1, 2, 3];
// list.push(4); // Error: Property 'push' does not exist on type 'readonly number[]'.
explanation_md: `readonly` ensures that the array cannot be modified after creation.
